message: The tram down to Alfama, that impossible sunset over the river, and pastéis de nata for breakfast three days running. I'd get lost in those hills with you again in a heartbeat.
Rain on the temple roofs and you insisting we find one more shrine before dark. We did. It was worth it. It's always worth it with you.
We froze, we laughed, we waited hours for the northern lights and then forgot to look up because we were talking. Best night of that whole year.
